selection.criterion: Equal random/wall mean paired total-time ratio to the fixed 16-channel control, with correct optimal paths and fewer expansions than Manhattan in both groups.

settings.timing: Fresh prediction and search per query. oracle_lookup excludes reference construction.
settings.neighbor_diagnostic: Fraction of undirected reachable neighbor pairs with |h(u)-h(v)| > 1. This diagnostic does not change selection.
settings.move_diagnostic: Choose the lowest predicted-distance legal neighbor, ties N,E,S,W; score whether BFS distance decreases by one.
